blocks.text: Thank you for the sales and service extracts; they came through clean, and we are already into them. The churn read is taking shape, and the early news is good: the leaving is concentrated in a narrower band of accounts than your team expected, and a concentrated problem is a more tractable one. Mary Parker has the customer and market background largely assembled and is filing the sources as she goes, so every figure we later put in front of you will have a home.

Two things would keep us moving. We still need the contract-renewal dates for the mid-tier accounts, which were not in the last extract, and I would like thirty minutes each with the two account managers your note flagged as closest to the customers who left. If those introductions are easier coming from you, Joseph Wallace, I am glad for the requests to go out under your name; the sessions can be short, and we will come to them with specific questions rather than a blank page.

I would also like to hold a working session late next month to walk your team through the first read of the churn pattern. I will send two or three dates once the renewal data is in, so that we meet with something solid in hand rather than a half-formed picture.

Send whatever is readiest directly to me, Deborah Jimenez, and I will get it to Mary Parker the same day. I will keep this thread as the running record for {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}} so nothing has to be chased twice.
